1. .spec/specs/append_only.spec.md — rewrite specled.append_only.same_pr_self_authorization statement to the D1 text (non-empty affects subset of weakened ids, weakened = removed OR scenario-regressed OR modal-downgraded OR polarity-stripped; warning severity, new-in-diff, visible-without-blocking clauses survive verbatim); ADD requirement specled.append_only.self_authorized_weakening (info marker, entity_id = weakened requirement id, fires only when the authorizing ADR is new in the current diff, names ADR id + weakening class in message; base-ADR authorizations emit nothing); add scenarios same_pr_scenario_regression_self_auth, same_pr_modal_downgrade_self_auth, same_pr_polarity_removal_self_auth (warning with ZERO deletions), self_authorized_weakening_marker, superset_affects_deletion_marker_without_warning, preexisting_adr_emits_no_self_auth_findings; keep scenario.same_pr_self_authorization_warning verbatim; add both new ids to the tagged_tests covers list and self_authorized_weakening to the source_file covers list; add the v2 ADR id to spec-meta decisions; update the Known v1 limits C3 bullet.
2. .spec/decisions/specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget_v2.md — supersedes-style ADR (change_type: supersedes, replaces the old budget ADR, affects [specled.append_only, specled.overlap]): 13-code budget table, per-code justification for the marker, matching-extension clause accounting (equality-on-removed -> subset-of-weakened). Flip old ADR status: accepted -> superseded (status line only).
3. lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex — analyze/4: compute new_adr_ids from new_in_diff; run the three regression detectors BEFORE self-auth computation; weakened_ids = removed union the three consulted sets; self_authorizing_adrs subset semantics (affects != [] and MapSet.subset?(MapSet.new(affects), weakened_ids)); uniform marker emission in all four detectors on the authorized-by-new-in-diff branch (and the covered-ids branch of detect_requirement_deleted); self_authorized_weakening_finding/5 constructor with fix block; same_pr_self_authorization_finding message reword; update the line-2 covers comment. Detector contract ({findings, consulted_ids}) and sort_findings unchanged.
4. test/specled_ex/append_only_test.exs — rework the line-267 test (weakening-set ADR suppresses scenario_regression) into the cross-PR negative case (ADR present in prior AND current decisions, assert [] still); extend the line-561 test to also assert the info marker; NEW tests per class (scenario-regression-only with zero deletions, must->SHOULD downgrade, polarity removal) each asserting class error absent + warning present (entity_id = ADR id) + marker present (entity_id = requirement id, message names ADR and class); superset-affects deletion test (marker yes, warning no, requirement_deleted suppressed); extend a pre-existing-ADR test to refute both self-auth codes; update @moduletag spec: list and line-2 covers comment; per-test @tag spec: carries the full union of asserted ids only.
5. test_support/append_only_fixtures.ex — only if a prior-state-decisions knob is genuinely needed.
6. .spec/realization_hashes.json — refresh SpecLedEx.AppendOnly.analyze/4.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: mix test test/specled_ex/append_only_test.exs (incl. all new per-class tests)
- Behaviors to demonstrate: the six new/updated scenarios above — headline: same-PR warning fires on a scenario-count regression with ZERO requirement deletions (old equality matching structurally cannot fire; new subset matching must), and every authorized-suppressed weakening by a new-in-diff ADR emits the info marker while base-ADR authorizations stay silent
- Verification cadence:

  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, run the full project verification (bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh — verdict is the last line starting with spec.check result=) run-until-green, plus mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref.
  - Verifier tier: flipped stubs and targeted/--stale selections only; do NOT run the full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Fixture/sandbox hygiene covered (pure-function tests over state fixtures; no DB/Oban)
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test (each weakening class x each of new-in-diff / base-ADR / superset-affects)
- Call-site Integration: no new callable surface. The new finding constructor is internal to AppendOnly.analyze/4; production consumption is the existing SpecLedEx.BranchCheck.run/3 -> spec.check findings pipeline (no wiring change); proving tests are the per-class analyze/4 assertions.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex, test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs, .spec/specs/verification.spec.md (Stage 1)
- lib/specled_ex/overlap.ex (despite the v2 ADR affects entry)
- .spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md
- VERSION, CHANGELOG.md (Stage 3)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):

- test/specled_ex/append_only_test.exs
- test_support/append_only_fixtures.ex (only if needed)
- .spec/specs/append_only.spec.md (stage-owned spec surgery per D1: one statement rewrite + additive requirement/scenarios/covers + stub flips execute:false->true)
- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget_v2.md (new)

- No changes to authorizing_decision/2 matching semantics, the weakening set, detect_missing_change_type, sort order, or any other finding code severity/entity shape
- No subject-level (prefix) matching anywhere — discrimination is ADR novelty at requirement-id granularity (D2); over-firing on legitimate cross-PR authorizations is the named failure mode
- Marker paths must keep putting ids into consulted sets (detector contract)
- If run in parallel with S1, resolve .spec/realization_hashes.json conflicts by keeping BOTH sides changed entries (distinct bindings) — never regenerate from the merged tree
